calendar_2024_2025_reason: Required by preregistered H3/H4 development horizons for 2022 and 2023 draft classes and by season-specific replacement baselines.
dob_rule: Pinned nflverse players.csv birth date first; historical nflverse roster birth date only as fallback.

dynastyprocess.name: db_playerids.csv
dynastyprocess.schema_role: GSIS-to-Sleeper fallback if historical roster sleeper_id is blank

notes: Season roster positions are used only for historical replacement-pool lineage.
Target rookie position prefers the frozen Phase-2 draft position.
The 2024 rookie holdout pick corpus is not read by Phase 3.

players.name: players.csv
players.schema_role: GSIS-keyed metadata/DOB; Players V2 intentionally excludes Sleeper IDs

position_lineage_rule: Replacement pool position is season-appropriate nflverse roster position mapped to Sleeper ID. Current Sleeper position is never used for historical replacement pools.
target_position_rule: Prefer frozen Phase-2 draft position; if absent, use nflverse roster position from the rookie's draft year only.
